featured_reviews.name: Jay Mody
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of sampling some incredible sweets from a new local company, Shreenathji Tiffins, a venture started by a close friend's wife. I was thrilled to support them and decided to order two classic Indian delicacies: puran poli and modak. What arrived was nothing short of a culinary masterpiece, and I am genuinely blown away by the care and quality that went into every bite.
​First, let's talk about the puran poli. Each piece was a testament to perfect craftsmanship. The most striking thing was the outer layer—it was incredibly thin, delicate, and cooked to golden perfection. It held the generous filling of puran (sweet lentil and jaggery) without being heavy or doughy. This thinness allowed the rich, earthy flavor of the filling to take center stage. The sweetness was absolutely spot on; it was a perfect balance that satisfied my craving without being cloying. It was clear that high-quality ingredients were used, as the flavors tasted authentic and fresh, reminding me of a true homemade treat.
​The modak were equally divine. They were beautifully crafted and had a soft, yielding texture. Biting into one revealed a flavorful filling of coconut and jaggery that was moist and fragrant. Just like with the puran poli, the sweetness was perfectly measured, creating a harmonious experience that was both comforting and indulgent. The careful preparation and excellent quality were evident in the consistent taste and texture of each modak.
​Overall, my experience with Shreenathji Tiffins was exceptional. It's rare to find sweets that are both delicious and made with such attention to detail. The perfect quantity of sweetness and the consistently good quality of both the puran poli and the modak show a true passion for cooking. I am already planning my next order and can't recommend them highly enough. If you’re looking for authentic, high-quality, and perfectly balanced Indian sweets, you must give Shreenathji Tiffins a try. You won't be disappointed!
